definitions.explanation: A request to purchase or receive something, especially in commercial contexts like restaurants or online shopping.
A specific requirement or condition requested.

notes:
COMMON PATTERNS:
- {注文|ちゅうもん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to order)
- {注文|ちゅうもん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧ (to take an order)
- {注文|ちゅうもん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}ける→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧ (to receive an order)
- ご{注文|ちゅうもん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧? (What would you like to order? - polite)

COMPOUNDS:
- {注文|ちゅうもん}⟦{書|しょ}→書：noentry⟧ (order form)
- {注文|ちゅうもん}⟦{住宅|じゅうたく}→住宅：03280_juutaku⟧ (custom-built house)
- ⟦{特別|とくべつ}→特別：01120_tokubetsu⟧{注文|ちゅうもん} (special order)

USAGE:
In restaurants, ご{注文|ちゅうもん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧お⟦{決|き}まり→決まる：01233_kimaru⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧ or ご{注文|ちゅうもん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧? is the standard way staff ask if you're ready to order.
